Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 18%.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — INC-0001 "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" is open, documenting the failure and the rollback. (The initial create call timed out, but the incident was created successfully.)

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
